# Task Template

## Task ID

RS-XXXX

## Title

Short task title.

## Status

Proposed / Approved / In progress / Implemented / Approved for merge / Merged

## Objective

One paragraph explaining the task.

## Expected visible change

None / Minor / Feature-visible.

## Allowed files

- `path/to/file.js`

## Forbidden files

- `app.js`
- `index.html`
- `style.css`
- renderer files unless explicitly allowed

## Requirements

1. Requirement one.
2. Requirement two.

## Out of scope

- Item one.
- Item two.

## Tests required

```bash
npm test
```

Additional tests if needed.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Criterion one.
- [ ] Criterion two.

## Commit message

```text
feat(scope): concise description
```

## Result package required

Paste:

```bash
git status
git diff --stat HEAD~1..HEAD
npm test
```

Then fill:

```text
TASK:
STATUS:
COMMIT:
FILES CHANGED:
TESTS RUN:
TEST RESULT:
VISIBLE CHANGE:
NOTES / WARNINGS:
NEXT RECOMMENDED STEP:
```
